description.zh: 坐席账号名称(唯一值)，外部账号与XP账号登录名的映射
description.en: The name of the agent account (unique value). This is the mapping between the external account and the XP account logon name.

description.zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
description.en: The unique client request ID used for idempotency checks. You can use a UUID.

description.zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
description.en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service instance. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console.
